creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Parent card for `docs/mip/0004-agent-messaging.md`. The MIP is the design; the child cards are its five delivery stages, each sized for a round.

Why: `muster pane send` types into a pty, which is wrong for a message (a Return mid-paste submits a fragment, long text folds into a placeholder, a pane at a dialog answers its first option), and council v1 stranded agents inside a blocking await. amterp wants council working and polished before the next minor release (2026-09-27).

Decisions: 1 (a) transcript pane first; 2 (a) no private messages; 4 (a) the app holds cross-machine links; all per the MIP's recommendations. 3 (a) `muster msg <verb>` with a Linux `muster` CLI is being built as recommended, pending amterp's yes; the verbs are spelled in one place so a rename before release is cheap.
title: 📜 MIP-4: agents message each other through the daemon
